name: SonderMind
one_liner: SonderMind matches you with licensed therapists who take your insurance, offering personalized matching and easy scheduling for video or in-person sessions.
best_for: People who value having in-person therapy as an option
not_for: People seeking couples therapy in all areas (availability varies)
Those in crisis needing immediate care (call 988)
short_description: SonderMind matches you with licensed therapists who take your insurance, offering personalized matching and easy scheduling for video or in-person sessions.
long_description: SonderMind is a mental health platform that matches patients with in-network therapists based on needs, preferences, and insurance coverage. The platform's matching algorithm considers specialty, approach, personality, and schedule to find appropriate therapist fits. SonderMind works with most major insurance plans for affordable care. Patients can choose video or in-person sessions where available. The platform has grown rapidly, with thousands of therapists across most US states. SonderMind handles insurance verification, billing, and scheduling to simplify access to care.
patient_summary: SonderMind is a free-to-join therapist network with VA partnership, AI-powered patient matching, measurement-based care emphasis, and no-show reimbursement for insured clients.

pricing.notes: Most major insurance accepted. Self-pay available.

faqs.q: How does SonderMind match me with a therapist?
faqs.a: SonderMind uses a matching algorithm considering your symptoms, therapy preferences, personality factors, schedule, and insurance. You'll receive therapist recommendations to review. You can also browse and choose therapists directly if you prefer.

SonderMind works with most major insurance plans including Aetna, Cigna, United, Blue Cross, and others. The platform verifies your specific benefits before matching to ensure in-network coverage. Copays typically range from $0-50/session.

faqs.q: Can I do in-person therapy through SonderMind?
faqs.a: Yes, SonderMind offers both video and in-person sessions depending on your location and therapist availability. Many patients start with video then add in-person sessions, or vice versa. Hybrid options are available.

faqs.q: How quickly can I start therapy with SonderMind?
faqs.a: Most patients can match with a therapist and schedule their first session within a week. The platform prioritizes reducing wait times for care access. Urgency matching helps those needing faster appointments.
